course-gc-leading-with-purpose.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns a leader examining whose interests their leadership serves and turning values into observable commitments.

course-gc-accountability-public-service.title: Personal Accountability in Public Service
course-gc-accountability-public-service.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns personal accountability in public service: inviting correction, owning mistakes and following through.

course-gc-leading-without-authority.title: Leading Without Formal Authority
course-gc-leading-without-authority.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns influence without formal authority: knowing who decides, building trust across teams and sharing credit.

course-gc-systems-thinking.title: Systems Thinking for Human Services Leaders
course-gc-systems-thinking.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns seeing a service as a system, mapping where people fall out and finding root causes.

course-gc-advising-decision-makers.title: Advising the Person Who Decides
course-gc-advising-decision-makers.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns preparing options and tradeoffs for a decision owner and explaining the decision back.

course-gc-delegation-and-development.title: Delegating Well and Growing Your Team
course-gc-delegation-and-development.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns delegating work with clear authority and support, and offering stretch work openly as development.

course-gc-setting-direction.title: Setting Direction and Priorities With an Equity Lens
course-gc-setting-direction.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns setting direction as a result for the people served and choosing priorities with their costs in view.

course-gc-leading-culture-at-scale.title: Leading Culture Across a Division
course-gc-leading-culture-at-scale.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns how senior leaders shape culture through what they reward, resource and tolerate.

course-gc-foresight-and-stewardship.title: Looking Ahead: Foresight and Stewardship
course-gc-foresight-and-stewardship.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns planning under uncertainty with simple foresight tools and what a leader leaves in place.

course-gc-knowledge-and-continuity.title: Sharing Knowledge and Learning Across Generations
course-gc-knowledge-and-continuity.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns sharing critical knowledge for continuity and learning in both directions across generations.

course-gc-disability-led-leadership.title: Learning From Disability-Led Leadership
course-gc-disability-led-leadership.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns what leaders learn from self-advocacy and disability-led leadership, sharing power with self-advocates and families, and leading frontline teams in that spirit.

course-gc-coaching-conversations.title: Coaching Conversations That Help People Grow
course-gc-coaching-conversations.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns holding coaching conversations that help colleagues grow, listening well, and offering coaching fairly.

course-cw-everyday-norms.title: Culture: How Everyday Norms Shape the Work
course-cw-everyday-norms.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns noticing unwritten team norms, telling a standard from perfectionism and responding to mistakes so people keep speaking up.

course-cw-sustainable-pace.title: Well-Being at Work: Sustainable Pace and Meaningful Work
course-cw-sustainable-pace.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns well-being as part of doing the work well over time: early signs, small protections, asking for support and the state Employee Assistance Program.

course-cw-pace-pressure-decisions.title: Pace, Pressure and Decision Quality
course-cw-pace-pressure-decisions.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns telling a true deadline from a habit of urgency, looking past output to outcomes and protecting decision quality under pressure.

course-cw-workload-burnout.title: Workload, Burnout and Team Practices That Help
course-cw-workload-burnout.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns the workplace conditions that drive burnout, workload conversations that lead to change and team practices that share the load and protect recovery.

course-cw-learning-organization.title: Building a Learning Organization
course-cw-learning-organization.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns leadership routines that let a division learn from its work: how bad news travels, blameless reviews and community voice before decisions are final.

course-cw-trauma-informed-teams.title: Trauma-Informed Practice for Teams and Leaders
course-cw-trauma-informed-teams.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns applying the six principles of a trauma-informed approach to spaces, processes and meetings, and supporting staff exposed to secondary traumatic stress.

course-cpn-01-understanding-organization.title: Understanding Organizational Culture
course-cpn-01-understanding-organization.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns how organizational culture shows up in DSD meetings, notices and supervision, and the cultural tensions public service holds.

course-cpn-02-how-culture-shapes-systems.title: How Culture Shapes Systems
course-cpn-02-how-culture-shapes-systems.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns how workplace norms become defaults in rules, forms, timelines and resources, and how systems thinking helps examine them.

course-cpn-03-okun-framework-reflective-.title: Tema Okun's Framework as a Reflective Tool
course-cpn-03-okun-framework-reflective-.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns using Tema Okun's characteristics as one reflective lens on organizational norms, with its strengths and critiques, without labeling people.

course-cpn-04-accessibility-disability-j.title: Accessibility, Disability Justice, and Organizational Culture
course-cpn-04-accessibility-disability-j.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns how workplace norms affect access, accommodation and participation, drawing on disability justice, Universal Design and plain language.

course-cpn-05-building-cultures-of-belon.title: Building Cultures of Belonging
course-cpn-05-building-cultures-of-belon.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns psychological safety, speaking up, receiving feedback and inclusive dialogue inside teams and with communities.

course-cpn-06-awareness-to-action.title: Moving From Awareness to Action
course-cpn-06-awareness-to-action.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns leading a plan, try, study, adjust cycle on one process, sharing decisions and measuring change in the work rather than tracking people.

course-gc-workforce-data-life-cycle.title: Reading Workforce Data Across the Employee Life Cycle
course-gc-workforce-data-life-cycle.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Read workforce data from application to separation as a chain of decisions, protect people where numbers are small, account for missing data such as disability self-identification, and turn a pattern into a question for the process rather than a verdict on a person.

course-gc-role-design-qualifications.title: Role Design and Minimum Qualifications That Measure the Job
course-gc-role-design-qualifications.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Write position descriptions and minimum qualifications that test what the work actually needs, so that essential functions, degree and experience requirements and language skills open the job to every qualified route and support accommodation from the start.

course-gc-classification-pay-equity.title: Classification, Pay and Unrecognized Work
course-gc-classification-pay-equity.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Recognize work that classification and pay decisions can miss, document duties accurately, and bring classification and pay questions to Human Resources and labor relations with the facts they need.

course-gc-workforce-change-equity.title: Reorganizations, Reassignments and Layoffs With an Equity Lens
course-gc-workforce-change-equity.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Plan a reorganization, reassignment or layoff so you can show who bears its effects, work within seniority and contract rules, keep accommodations in place, communicate fairly and check the result afterward.

course-gc-disability-employment-goals.title: Employing and Keeping People With Disabilities in State Service
course-gc-disability-employment-goals.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Read Minnesota's goals for employing people with disabilities accurately, interpret self-identified counts with their limits in view, and lead the retention, advancement and accommodation systems that decide whether those goals are met.

course-gc-affirmative-action-workforce-g.title: Affirmative Action Plans and Workforce Goals in Minnesota State Government
course-gc-affirmative-action-workforce-g.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Explain what an agency affirmative action plan is and is not under Minnesota law, tell a workforce goal from a quota, keep goals working on recruitment and process rather than on individual hires, and act on your unit's numbers with their limits in view.

course-gc-civil-rights-federally-funded-.title: Civil Rights in Federally Funded Programs: Title VI, Section 504 and Section 1557
course-gc-civil-rights-federally-funded-.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Trace how Title VI, Section 504 and Section 1557 attach to a federally funded DSD program and its subrecipients, and build language access, program access and reasonable modification into a program's design before launch rather than after complaints.

course-gc-mhra-public-services.title: The Minnesota Human Rights Act in Public Services and Program Design
course-gc-mhra-public-services.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Apply the Minnesota Human Rights Act's public services provisions to program design: test a new or revised rule for disparate treatment, unequal effects and disability access, and build reasonable modification and a record of reasoning in before the rule goes out.

course-gc-integration-mandate-practice.title: The Integration Mandate in Practice: Olmstead and the HCBS Settings Rule
course-gc-integration-mandate-practice.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Reason through integration questions after the 2026 federal changes by separating the ADA, the HCBS settings rule and Minnesota law, and work through hard cases on isolating settings, informed choice and provider capacity.

course-gc-guardianship-supported-decisio.title: Guardianship, Supported Decision-Making and Less Restrictive Alternatives
course-gc-guardianship-supported-decisio.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Explain what Minnesota law requires before guardianship, compare supported decision-making and other less restrictive alternatives, protect the rights a person keeps under guardianship, and support people's own decisions without giving legal advice.

course-gc-accessibility-program-governan.title: Running an Accessibility Program: Standards, Exceptions and Accountability
course-gc-accessibility-program-governan.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Govern an accessibility program that covers digital and physical access: match each duty to an owner and a decision maker, set priorities you can defend from an incomplete inventory, keep exceptions narrow and reviewed, use procurement to prevent barriers, and report progress in terms a reader can check.

course-gc-accessibility-barrier-remediat.title: When an Accessibility Barrier Is Reported: Triage, Remediation and Equally Effective Access
course-gc-accessibility-barrier-remediat.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Respond to a reported accessibility barrier so the person gets effective access now, judge whether an alternative is truly as effective, fix the barrier where it is made rather than in one copy, tell the person what changed, and use the pattern of reports to improve the program.

course-cn-what-a-navigator-does.title: What a Cultural Navigator Does
course-cn-what-a-navigator-does.basis: reviewed course/resource purpose: Course purpose concerns what a cultural navigator does, how the role differs from an interpreter, a cultural broker and a case manager, where culture changes the meaning of an answer in disability services, and how staff work alongside a navigator with the person's agreement.
